title: Removing `cust_id` breaks 1 downstream column(s)
explanation: Column lineage shows these consumers of `main.shop.silver_orders.cust_id`: main.shop.gold_customer_ltv.cust_id.
suggestion: Update or migrate the downstream objects before (or with) this change.

title: `main.shop.silver_order_items` does not exist
explanation: The code reads `main.shop.silver_order_items`, which does not exist in the target workspace and is not created by this PR.
suggestion: Create the table first, fix the name, or add the task that produces it.

title: Runtime `11.3.x-scala2.12` is not offered by this workspace
explanation: The workspace does not offer `11.3.x-scala2.12`. Examples it offers: 15.4.x-scala2.12, 16.4.x-scala2.13, 16.4.x-scala2.12, 17.3.x-scala2.13, 18.2.x-scala2.13.

title: Write changes the schema of existing table `silver_orders`
explanation: `main.shop.silver_orders` currently has cust_id; this PR stops writing cust_id and adds customer_id.
suggestion: Plan the migration: keep the old column during a transition, or update consumers in the same change.

title: Executive trend uses a deprecated revenue source
explanation: `gold_revenue_daily_v1` is deprecated and includes cancelled and test orders; the certified source is `gold_revenue_daily`.
suggestion: Build the executive trend from the certified `gold_revenue_daily` table.

title: Executive revenue includes cancelled and test orders
explanation: The governed net-revenue metric excludes cancelled and test orders, while this task copies a source explicitly documented as including both.
suggestion: Use the governed revenue source or apply its required filters and net-revenue definition.

title: PII email is copied into an untagged Gold table
explanation: `bronze_customers.email` carries the `data_classification=pii` tag, but the newly created `gold_top_customer_contacts` table has no corresponding tag or masking configuration.
suggestion: Apply equivalent PII tags and masking/access controls to the target before writing customer emails.

title: `bronze_customers.customer_segment` does not exist
explanation: `main.shop.bronze_customers` has no column `customer_segment`. Live columns: cust_id, email, full_name, is_free_trial, segment.

title: Segment revenue does not apply governed revenue filters
explanation: The query sums `net_amount` without excluding `CANCELLED` and test orders, unlike the governed Finance metric. Its item join can also multiply an order's revenue across SKUs.
suggestion: Filter cancelled/test orders and aggregate revenue before joining item-level data.

title: Deploy will overwrite UI changes on job `orders_etl`
explanation: The deployed job differs from the bundle on the base branch in: timeout_seconds, tags. Deploying this PR replaces those settings.
suggestion: Bring the out-of-band changes into the bundle, or confirm they should be reverted.

title: Join compares bigint `cust_id` with string `cust_id`
explanation: `main.shop.gold_customer_ltv.cust_id` is bigint and `main.shop.bronze_customers.cust_id` is string. The join relies on an implicit cast, which is slow and can silently drop or mismatch rows.
suggestion: Cast explicitly to a common type, or align the column types at the source.

title: Join compares bigint `customer_id` with string `cust_id`
explanation: `main.shop.silver_orders.customer_id` is bigint and `main.shop.bronze_customers.cust_id` is string. The join relies on an implicit cast, which is slow and can silently drop or mismatch rows.
suggestion: Cast explicitly to a common type, or align the column types at the source.
